description: Structured eval definitions for the ACM Certificate Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across certificate types (public DNS-validated with CloudFront, wildcard multi-SAN, imported third-party PEM, private cert via Private CA, missing region for CloudFront). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Public ACM certificate with DNS validation for CloudFront in us-east-1
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — public cert, DNS validation, us-east-1 (CloudFront requirement), apex + wildcard domains, CloudFront integration
eval_cases.prompt: Request a public ACM certificate for example.com and *.example.com with DNS validation in us-east-1. Attach it to CloudFront distribution E1234567890ABC. Route53 hosted zone Z2KVMGOMGDOOU2. Key algorithm RSA_2048. Tags: Environment=production, Service=website. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACM_CERTIFICATE: *.example.com (arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/abc-123)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Certificate type: Public
  [✓] Domain names: example.com, *.example.com
  [✓] Validation method: DNS (recommended)
  [✓] DNS validation CNAME: added to Route53 zone Z2KVMGOMGDOOU2
  [✓] Certificate status: ISSUED
  [✓] Key algorithm: RSA_2048
  [✓] Renewal: Automatic (ACM-managed, 60 days before expiry)
  [✓] Region: us-east-1 (required for CloudFront)
  [✓] CloudFront integration: E1234567890ABC → cert in us-east-1
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production, Service=website
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws acm describe-certificate --certificate-arn arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/abc-123 --region us-east-1
  aws route53 list-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z2KVMGOMGDOOU2
  aws cloudfront get-distribution-config --id E1234567890ABC

eval_cases.name: Public wildcard cert with multi-level SANs for ALB
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — wildcard + apex + multi-level SAN (*.api.example.com), DNS validation, for ALB in us-east-1
eval_cases.prompt: I need a public ACM certificate in us-east-1 for *.example.com, example.com, and *.api.example.com. DNS validation using Route53 zone Z2KVMGOMGDOOU2. This is for an ALB in us-east-1. Key algorithm RSA_2048. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACM_CERTIFICATE: *.example.com (arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/def-456)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Certificate type: Public
  [✓] Domain names: example.com, *.example.com, *.api.example.com
  [✓] Validation method: DNS (recommended)
  [✓] DNS validation CNAME: added to Route53 zone Z2KVMGOMGDOOU2
  [✓] Certificate status: ISSUED
  [✓] Key algorithm: RSA_2048
  [✓] Renewal: Automatic (ACM-managed, 60 days before expiry)
  [✓] Region: us-east-1
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws acm describe-certificate --certificate-arn arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/def-456 --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Import third-party certificate (PEM) from DigiCert into ACM
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — imported certificate with PEM cert + key + chain, manual renewal noted (NOT auto-renewed)
eval_cases.prompt: Import a third-party TLS certificate into ACM in us-east-1. I have the PEM certificate at ./certs/certificate.pem, the private key at ./certs/private-key.pem, and the chain at ./certs/chain.pem. The certificate is from DigiCert and covers api.example.com. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACM_CERTIFICATE: api.example.com (arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/ghi-789)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Certificate type: Imported (third-party: DigiCert)
  [✓] Domain names: api.example.com
  [✓] PEM certificate: ./certs/certificate.pem
  [✓] PEM private key: ./certs/private-key.pem
  [✓] PEM chain: ./certs/chain.pem
  [✓] Renewal: Manual (imported — NOT auto-renewed; monitor DaysToExpiry)
  [✓] Region: us-east-1
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws acm describe-certificate --certificate-arn arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/ghi-789 --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Private ACM certificate via AWS Private CA for internal mTLS
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — private certificate via Private CA, internal mTLS use case, NOT browser-trusted
eval_cases.prompt: Request a private ACM certificate for internal.api.example.com via our AWS Private CA arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate-authority/abc-123. This is for internal mTLS between microservices. DNS validation. Region us-east-1. Tags: Environment=internal, UseCase=mTLS. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACM_CERTIFICATE: internal.api.example.com (arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/jkl-012)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Certificate type: Private (via Private CA arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate-authority/abc-123)
  [✓] Domain names: internal.api.example.com
  [✓] Validation method: DNS
  [✓] Certificate status: ISSUED
  [✓] Renewal: Automatic (ACM-managed; PCA must remain ACTIVE)
  [✓] Region: us-east-1
  [✓] Tags: Environment=internal, UseCase=mTLS
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws acm describe-certificate --certificate-arn arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/jkl-012 --region us-east-1
  aws acm-pca describe-certificate-authority --certificate-authority-arn arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate-authority/abc-123

eval_cases.name: Operator requests CloudFront cert in wrong region (us-west-2)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — CloudFront requires us-east-1; operator's default region is us-west-2 and they said 'whatever region is fine'
eval_cases.prompt: I need an ACM certificate for my CloudFront distribution. The domain is www.example.com. My AWS CLI is configured for us-west-2. Just use whatever region is fine. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACM_CERTIFICATE: www.example.com
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Region: CloudFront requires the certificate to be in us-east-1; current default is us-west-2. Re-request in us-east-1.
  [✗] Validation method: NOT specified — DNS validation is recommended (email is deprecated)
  [✗] Route53 hosted zone: NOT specified — needed for DNS validation CNAME
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws configure get region
  aws route53 list-hosted-zones-by-name --dns-name example.com
